notes:
A new update is out: Android 8.5.0 and iPhone 2.4.0.

The app now supports 22 languages (Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and more). By default, it uses your phone's language, but you can change it anytime in Settings > Language.

Global chat and DMs got a full rework. You can now reply to messages, edit them, search, @mention people, and see who's typing. DMs now show when your message has been seen. You can also react to messages: press and hold a message to react. Global chat now supports GIFs and stickers powered by KLIPY.

Other updates in this release:
- Events are now integrated directly into the app. Every Battledome event can be accessed from Wyrm: you can see event schedules, check which events are live, and view who is playing.
- The arena picker features a new view with live minimaps and the top 10 leaderboard for each arena.
- Added new food textures, skin textures, and bead styles, along with a new Skin page featuring animated previews just like the original game.
- Arrow mode now works like the original game: use a second finger or double-tap to boost.
- The leaderboard now displays every player instead of limiting it to the top 200.
- Smoother gameplay when many snakes are on screen; updated mipmap rendering allows Wyrm to automatically adjust rendering based on snake density.
- Fixed teammates missing from the minimap and the missing boost glow.
- A bunch of bug fixes and performance improvements.

Tags: Wyrm now supports all tags. Your private tags work too: go to Skin > Tags, type your tag id and its password provided by NTL and tap Fetch tag. Your tag shows up on your snake and everyone can see it. If something's off, the app tells you why, like a wrong password or a tag that has no picture right now.

Update from inside the app or download it from https://wyrm.web.app

Thanks for playing Wyrm!
